subject: note: Football season is over. No more games. No more bombs. No more walking. No more fun. No more swimming. 67. 17 years past 50. 17 more than I needed or wanted. Boring. I am always bitchy. No fun for anybody. 67, you are getting greedy. Act your old age. Relax. This won’t hurt.
